_source: Moja Orca web app (mojaorca.orcaenergy.eu), service mode, recorded 2026-10-30 by @rp9376 on the test pump (schema 23, DK1+MK2+SV+SOLAR): once with the SI UI, once with the EN UI. Derived from research/captures/moja_orca_si.har and moja_orca_en.har (gitignored). *_sl texts come from the SI UI, *_en from the EN UI; a few SI-UI labels are English because the app has no Slovenian text for them.
_encoding: Values and min/max are raw pump integers: cdegrees and float types are x10 (280 = 28.0). Enum values are indexes into values_sl. observed_value is what this pump had at recording time. observed_value is from the SI recording; info_page_snapshot_en was taken ~3 h later, so its live values differ.
